title: Tötungsdelikt zum Nachteil der 13-jährigen Lisa T. – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen zu einem Fahrzeug

extraction.summaryEn: A 13-year-old girl who disappeared on her way to school in Marzahn was found dead on 8 November 2026 in an empty building in Altglietzen, Brandenburg. Police are investigating a homicide and seeking witnesses who saw a silver Citroën C5 estate car.
